name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task says reaching the exit requires a prior switch flip, which is Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard. The task does not command reaching the exit unconditionally, so no Existence is needed, and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: The agent must have toggled the switch before it reaches the exit; reaching the exit is not allowed before the switch has been flipped.
